evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: we talked to a lot of people everyday and most of them have one or two concerns for the move. Either the mover is not showing up on time or damage their items or either of those a concern for you.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'I guess if they damage my items' and rep acknowledged but immediately pivoted to the damage coverage promise rather than asking 'tell me more about that' or probing deeper into the concern.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep never mentioned or explored which day of the week the October 25th move falls on, never offered alternative dates, never gave a total dollar savings comparison.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep jumped directly to 'would you like our help with your upcoming move?' with no mention of rate lock or no-deposit guarantee before asking. Customer declined and rep sent follow-up email instead of confirming details or re-engaging.

top_strength: Jevic delivered both promises (On-Time Guarantee with specific discounting terms and No Worries Damage Coverage with the $2,000 limit and no deductible) clearly and early, with full transparency on what Einstein covers.
coaching_note: When the customer raises a concern in step 2, go two layers deep with 'tell me more about that' and silence rather than immediately pivoting to your solution—let them finish first. Also: always lead with rate lock and no-deposit guarantee before asking for the business, and hold for their answer after you ask 'Would you like our help?'
